name: Mauricio Ramírez L.
headline: Backend Software Engineer | Distributed Systems & Microservices | .NET / C# | REST API Design | CI/CD & Cloud Infrastructure
summary: Backend Software Engineer with 10+ years building and scaling distributed backend systems in finance and retail. Deep expertise in .NET, microservices architecture, REST API design, and CI/CD pipelines — proven track record of reducing latency, improving deployment reliability, and shipping high-volume transaction systems in remote, cross-functional teams.

bullets: Architected and built 10+ scalable microservices with .NET Framework/Core for inventory forecasting systems processing millions of records daily.
Designed and optimized RESTful APIs, cutting average response time by 25–35% through caching, error handling, and versioning strategies.
Partnered with product teams to deliver backend solutions that improved forecast accuracy and reduced stock discrepancies across global retail operations.
Standardized CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), reducing deployment time by 40% and enabling multiple weekly releases with >95% success rate.
Enforced code quality through SonarQube and unit testing, reducing production defects by 30% and improving long-term maintainability.
Contributed to high-volume backend systems supporting a global retail client, enabling scalable inventory processing and real-time decision-making.
Developed microservices in .NET and Java for financial transaction systems processing high-volume digital credit operations.
Implemented asynchronous processing integrations (JBoss Fuse), improving system throughput by 30% and reducing transaction latency.
Centralized business rules with JBoss BRMS, cutting manual intervention and accelerating credit approvals by 20–25%.
Contributed to system design incorporating fault-tolerant patterns, improving resilience and reducing service downtime.
Delivered backend services powering production digital credit and mobile wallet platforms.
Automated decision logic to eliminate operational bottlenecks, improving processing efficiency and consistency.
Built backend APIs and web applications in .NET Core and SQL Server, improving data accessibility and business operations performance.
Optimized SQL queries and stored procedures, reducing reporting execution time by 30–40%.
Developed Power BI dashboards that cut reporting turnaround from days to hours, enabling faster data-driven decisions.
Maintained and enhanced HR and finance backend systems, improving reliability and reducing support incidents by 20%.
Built reporting tools that automated administrative workflows, saving dozens of manual hours per month.
Collaborated with stakeholders to implement system improvements aligned with operational needs.
